lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gills. Centroids are most densely clustered in the mid-lateral region, forming approximately five identifiable linear trajectories.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a rectangular grid-like distribution of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral) along a horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A single Echeneidae specimen (remora) is visible attached to the dorsal midline, positioned approximately above the fourth and fifth branchial slits.
